title: The year 1966
summary: The boxed heading \ru{1966 г.} marks the resumption of the notebook. It contains no mathematical assertion. The attached catalogue gives a wider overlapping page range; the heading itself is on \GSpage{P000124}.

speaker: A. G. Kushnirenko
title: On invariant dynamical systems: title only
summary: Only Kushnirenko\textquotesingle s name, date and the title \ru{Об инвариантных динамических систем} survive. No definition of the invariant, theorem or proof follows before Gelfand\textquotesingle s heading. This is not sufficient evidence for identifying the talk with Kushnirenko\textquotesingle s entropy estimates from the preceding year (1964-10.2--3). Accordingly it has no invented mathematical item.

speaker: I. M. Gelfand
title: Ore fractions, Weyl fields, automorphisms and dimension
summary: The page begins with the Ore property and division rings of fractions, then distinguishes differential-operator rings \(R_{n,k}\) and their quotient division rings \(D_{n,k}\), introduces multiplicative leading symbols, and asks about determinants and all automorphisms. It ends with the growth definition of dimension and \(\dim R_{n,k}=2n+k\). The dimension formula in the handwriting lacks a logarithm in the numerator. Much of the page matches \citet{gelfandkirillov1966corps}; the paper was received on 19 January 1966, before this talk, but published afterwards. The general Gelfand--Kirillov conjecture for enveloping division rings is in that paper, not stated on this notebook page, and is not imported as a seminar item.
